# Tracy Profiler Client Library

This directory contains the client runtime of the [Tracy Profiler](https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy) (version 0.11.1).

## License

Tracy is licensed under the 3-Clause BSD License. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for full details.

## Structure

- `include/`: Tracy client header files (`tracy/`, `client/`, `common/`, `libbacktrace/`).
- `src/TracyClient.cpp`: Tracy single translation unit implementation.
